notes.title: Patch Note April 13
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

1. Fixed the issue where restarting the game would reset music and sound effects settings.
2. Fixed the issue where certain resolutions were not responsive after being adjusted.
3. Fixed the issue of incorrect layering of some objects within the game scenes.

Thanks all for your support and feedback! We'll keep working on the game to offer you better game experiences. 
And if you like little Sophia the Traveler, a positive review would be much appreciated! Thanks! <3
